title: A member with a personal training pack sees the pack's last day in their app as their plan's last day
what: The sell sheet sells a personal training pack beside the gym plan, and the admin panel keeps the two apart: the member's status, 'ends in N days' and renewals follow the gym plan only. The member's app does not. It takes whichever plan covering today ends last, pack or gym plan. So a member whose gym plan ends in 5 days but whose 3-month pack runs on sees the pack's name and its far-off last day, gets no 'renew soon' line and no 'plan ends soon' reminders, while the panel lists them as ending. The other way round, when the gym plan ends last, the app hides the pack's sessions left. A pack sold to start later counts as 'a plan paid ahead' and switches off all plan-ending reminders.
expected: The member's app shows the same last day and the same 'ends in N days' as the panel: the gym plan's chain, with the training pack shown as its own line.
who: members with a personal training pack, and their gym
how_often: every member whose training pack and gym plan end on different days
fix_line: Have the member's plan answer pick the gym plan for the last day and send the training pack separately

title: The sell sheet's 'Still due after this' leaves out money the member already owed on earlier plans
what: When the desk renews a member who still owes on an earlier plan, the sell sheet's 'Still due after this' shows only what is left of this sale, and shows nothing at all when this sale is paid in full. The member page, the Dues list and Collect payment ('due in total') all show the member's whole dues, so the desk can tell the member 'you're clear' when they are not.
expected: The sell sheet names any earlier dues next to this sale's balance, for example 'Still due on this plan: Rs 500. They also owe Rs 1,000 from before.'
how_often: every renewal of a member who still owes
fix_line: Show the member's older dues on the sell sheet beside this sale's balance

evidence: data-count: Crispy Curves has 2 live memberships, 0 PT packs, 0 upcoming plans (plain SQL, gym filter)
